name: Point Upsampling Diffusion
definition: A generative model that samples a dense surface point cloud $x_d$ from a sparse input point cloud $x_s$ by progressively denoising Gaussian noise, conditioned on a sparse prior point cloud $z_0$. It solves the lack of dense large-scale outdoor point cloud ground truth by learning a super-resolution distribution.
summary: Point Upsampling Diffusion generates dense point clouds from sparse inputs via progressive denoising, sampling regions rather than individual points to facilitate new viewpoint synthesis.
